bridge-type.label: AWTRIX NG Clock
bridge-type.description: Clock running the AWTRIX NG firmware

channel.label: Button Left
channel.description: Left button pressed or released

channel.label: Button Right
channel.description: Right button pressed or released

channel.label: Button Select
channel.description: Select button pressed or released

channel.label: Display Power
channel.description: Switches the display ON or OFF

channel.label: Automatic App Rotation
channel.description: Rotate through the apps automatically

channel.label: Transition Effect
channel.description: Animation between apps

channel.label: Transition Direction
channel.description: Reverses directional transitions

channel.label: Transition Duration
channel.description: Length of the animation between apps, 0 for instant

channel.label: App Duration
channel.description: Display time per app and default duration of a notification

channel.label: Block Button Navigation
channel.description: Disable app switching, display toggle and menu with the buttons. Button events are still reported.

channel.label: Master Volume
channel.description: Master volume, 0 silences everything

channel.label: App Volume
channel.description: Share of the master volume for the sounds of scripts

channel.label: Alert Volume
channel.description: Share of the master volume for notifications and alerts

channel.label: Clock Style
channel.description: Layout of the clock app

channel.label: 24 Hour Clock
channel.description: 24 hour format, otherwise 12 hour

channel.label: Leading Zero
channel.description: Show the hour with two digits

channel.label: Show Seconds
channel.description: Show the seconds in the clock

channel.label: Show AM/PM
channel.description: Show AM or PM, needs the 12 hour format and hidden when seconds are shown

channel.label: Clock Separator
channel.description: Behavior of the colon of the clock

channel.label: Date Order
channel.description: Order of day, month and year

channel.label: Date Separator
channel.description: Character between the parts of the date

channel.label: Date Year
channel.description: How the year is shown

channel.label: Date Weekday
channel.description: Prepend the weekday to the date

channel.label: Date Month Names
channel.description: Use three letter month names instead of numbers

channel.label: Use Celsius
channel.description: Show the temperature in Celsius, otherwise in Fahrenheit

channel.label: Uppercase
channel.description: Show pushed apps and notifications in capitals

channel.label: Text Color
channel.description: Default text color

channel.label: Clock Color
channel.description: Text color of the clock

channel.label: Date Color
channel.description: Text color of the date

channel.label: Temperature Color
channel.description: Text color of the temperature app

channel.label: Humidity Color
channel.description: Text color of the humidity app

channel.label: Battery Color
channel.description: Text color of the battery app

channel.label: Calendar Header Color
channel.description: Top bar of the calendar box

channel.label: Calendar Text Color
channel.description: Day number of the calendar box

channel.label: Calendar Body Color
channel.description: Background of the calendar box

channel.label: Weekday Bar
channel.description: Show the weekday bar of the clock app

channel.label: Week Starts on Monday
channel.description: The weekday bar starts on Monday, otherwise on Sunday

channel.label: Weekday Bar Active Color
channel.description: Color of the current day if it is a workday

channel.label: Weekday Bar Inactive Color
channel.description: Color of the other workdays

thing-type.label: AWTRIX NG App
thing-type.description: A pushed app of an AWTRIX NG clock

channel.label: Text
channel.description: Text of the app. Parts between <font color="#RRGGBB"> and </font> are colored, text outside of the tags is white.

channel.label: Text Case
channel.description: Upper or lower case of the text. inherit follows the uppercase setting of the clock.

channel.label: Font
channel.description: Font of the text

channel.label: Text Color
channel.description: Color of the text. Setting it switches the text palette off.

channel.label: Text Palette
channel.description: Color the text from the palette of the app. Setting a text color switches it off.

channel.label: Text Blink
channel.description: Blink period of the text, 0 for off

channel.label: Text Fade
channel.description: Period of a smooth fade in and out of the text, 0 for off

channel.label: Text Alignment
channel.description: Where text that fits the display sits

channel.label: Text Offset
channel.description: Moves the text left or right, in pixels

channel.label: Text In Front
channel.description: Draw the text on top of charts and drawings

channel.label: Scroll Mode
channel.description: How the text moves

channel.label: Scroll Direction
channel.description: Direction the text travels

channel.label: Scroll Entry
channel.description: Where the text starts, inline or offscreen

channel.label: Scroll When Fits
channel.description: Whether text that fits the display still moves

channel.label: Scroll Speed
channel.description: Scroll speed in percent of the base speed

channel.label: Scroll Gap
channel.description: Gap between the repetitions of a looping text, in pixels

channel.label: Scroll Hold
channel.description: Pause before and between the movements of the text

channel.label: Icon
channel.description: ID of an icon, or an image as a data URL (data:image/gif;base64,... or data:image/jpeg;base64,...)

channel.label: Icon Mode
channel.description: Whether the icon stays or moves with the text

channel.label: Icon Offset
channel.description: Moves the icon left or right, in pixels

channel.label: Icon Gap
channel.description: Space between the icon and the text, in pixels

channel.label: Extra Icons
channel.description: JSON array of at most 4 extra icons, e.g. [{"icon":"1234","x":0,"y":0}]

channel.label: Duration
channel.description: How long the app is shown, 0 for the default of the clock

channel.label: Lifetime
channel.description: How long the app lives without an update, 0 for forever

channel.label: Lifetime Expiry
channel.description: Whether an expired app is removed or only marked

channel.label: Repeat
channel.description: Number of scroll cycles, 0 for off

channel.label: Bar Chart
channel.description: Comma separated values of a bar chart, at most the newest 16

channel.label: Line Chart
channel.description: Comma separated values of a line chart, at most the newest 16

channel.label: Chart Autoscale
channel.description: Scale the chart to its values instead of a fixed range

channel.label: Chart Color
channel.description: Color of the chart, the text color if not set

channel.label: Progress
channel.description: Progress bar in percent, -1 switches it off

channel.label: Progress Color
channel.description: Color of the filled part of the progress bar

channel.label: Progress Track Color
channel.description: Color of the empty part of the progress bar

channel.label: Background Color
channel.description: Color of the background

channel.label: Background Effect
channel.description: Animated background of the app

channel.label: Effect Speed
channel.description: Speed of the effect, from 0.1 to 10

channel.label: Palette
channel.description: Name of a built-in palette, or colors separated by commas (#RRGGBB,#RRGGBB)

channel.label: Palette Blend
channel.description: Smooth instead of hard transitions between the colors of the palette

channel.label: Palette Span
channel.description: Pixels after which the palette repeats, 0 to stretch it over the text

channel.label: Palette Speed
channel.description: Speed of the palette animation, 0 for none

channel.label: Weather Overlay
channel.description: Weather effect over the app

channel.label: Draw Commands
channel.description: JSON array of draw commands, e.g. [["pixel",1,2,"#FF0000"]]

channel.label: Active
channel.description: The app is shown on the clock right now

channel.label: Enabled
channel.description: Switches the app in the rotation of the clock on or off

channel.label: Reset
channel.description: Sets the app back to its defaults

channel.label: Button Left
channel.description: Left button pressed or released while the app is locked for button control

channel.label: Button Right
channel.description: Right button pressed or released while the app is locked for button control

channel.label: Button Select
channel.description: Select button pressed or released while the app is locked for button control

channel-type.label: Active App
channel-type.description: App currently shown on the screen. A command switches to the app with that name.

channel-type.label: Automatic Brightness
channel-type.description: Let the clock set the brightness automatically based on its light sensor

channel-type.label: Battery Voltage
channel-type.description: Battery voltage calculated from the battery pin

channel-type.label: Display Brightness
channel-type.description: Screen brightness in percent. Setting it switches the automatic brightness off.

channel-type.label: Command Error
channel-type.description: Triggered with the JSON reported by the clock when it rejected a command

channel-type.label: Frame Rate
channel-type.description: Actual display refresh rate in frames per second

channel-type.label: Free Memory
channel-type.description: Free heap memory of the clock

channel-type.label: Indicator
channel-type.description: Color of the indicator dot. ON uses green, OFF or black switches the indicator off.

channel-type.label: IP Address
channel-type.description: Network address of the clock

channel-type.label: Light Level
channel-type.description: Ambient light as a relative percentage (not lux)

channel-type.label: WiFi Signal
channel-type.description: RSSI value of the WiFi signal

channel-type.label: Play RTTTL
channel-type.description: Plays a melody in RTTTL notation, e.g. "two:d=4,o=5,b=200:c,e"

channel-type.label: Screen Mirror
channel-type.description: Image of the screen of the clock. It is refreshed when the app changes, or on a REFRESH command.

channel-type.label: Play Sound
channel-type.description: Plays the stored sound with the given name

channel-type.label: Uptime
channel-type.description: Time since the last start of the clock

channel-type.label: Switch
channel-type.description: Switch setting

channel-type.label: Color
channel-type.description: Color setting

channel-type.label: Percentage
channel-type.description: Percentage setting

channel-type.label: Duration
channel-type.description: Duration in milliseconds. A command without a unit is taken as milliseconds.

channel-type.label: Transition Effect
channel-type.description: Animation between apps

channel-type.label: Transition Direction
channel-type.description: Direction of directional transitions

channel-type.label: Clock Style
channel-type.description: Layout of the clock app
